verdict.rationale: Using the desktop in your own language is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents system interface languages, localization or community translations. The only translation-related item (automatic translations in calls and messages) is a communication feature, not localization of the desktop UI, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use the desktop in my own language thanks to community or official translations
